title: Decoding a Quantified Boolean Formula
statement: For a Boolean string, first attempt to decode it as a pair consisting of a quantifier-bit list and a CNF-matrix encoding. If this succeeds, replace each quantifier bit by its corresponding quantifier and decode the matrix; if it fails, return the formula with an empty quantifier list and the fallback CNF matrix.
